page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture general-purpose server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 16 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance features 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying instead on network-attached storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the single-core performance of the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor is relatively weak, falling into the bottom 25% for stress-ng single-core CPU tests and the bottom 10% for single-threaded gzip compression and bzip3 decompression. However, the 16 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance, as evidenced by middle-tier results in multi-threaded stress-ng, PassMark CPU, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression tests. Memory bandwidth for both small cached blocks and large uncached blocks remains in the average tier, supporting steady throughput for memory-bound tasks.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2ne.4xlarge is its lower single-threaded execution speed, which limits its effectiveness for highly sequential processing tasks. Conversely, its dedicated CPU allocation and balanced memory-to-vCPU ratio provide stable, predictable performance for multi-threaded workloads. This profile is suitable for general-purpose workloads such as static web serving, Redis database operations, and moderate multi-threaded application hosting, while it is less optimal for intensive single-threaded computations or large-scale LLM inference.
